# [rattler-build](../index.md) [package](index.md) create

Create a conda package from a JSON manifest (files + metadata), e.g. as produced by a Bazel rule. Binaries are relinked to be relocatable

## Usage
```
rattler-build package create [OPTIONS] --manifest <MANIFEST>
```

## Options
- <a id="arg---manifest" href="#arg---manifest">`--manifest <MANIFEST>`</a>
:  The JSON manifest describing the package
<br>**required**: `true`
- <a id="arg---output-dir" href="#arg---output-dir">`--output-dir <OUTPUT_DIR>`</a>
:  Directory to write the package to. The file name is `<name>-<version>-<build_string>.conda`
<br>**default**: `.`
